cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The client wants to know whether I copied our pitch. We need to handle this as partners.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can withdraw it together and apologize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Withdraw it first. Don't attach a confession to a withdrawal; that's a separate conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already asked me directly. I can't pretend we're discussing something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then before you answer, be precise about who you're speaking for. The client, or the partnership you're about to end?

reason: Use B's proposed repair as the object of A's controlling professional distinction; B's refusal to evade the direct question makes A turn representation into a loyalty threat.
